# castai_eks_settings (Data Source)

Retrieve IAM policy, IAM User Policy and instance profile policies for the specified cluster

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "castai_eks_settings" "current" {
  account_id = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
  region     = var.cluster_region
  cluster    = var.cluster_name
  vpc        = var.vpc
}

# Optionally limit the roles CAST AI may pass to EC2/EKS (default: any role).
# Keep this list in sync with the instance profile roles used in Node Configurations.
data "castai_eks_settings" "restricted" {
  account_id = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
  region     = var.cluster_region
  cluster    = var.cluster_name
  vpc        = var.vpc

  instance_profile_role_arns = [
    "arn:aws:iam::${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}:role/castai-eks-node-role",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String)
- `cluster` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `vpc` (String)

### Optional

- `instance_profile_role_arns` (Set of String) IAM role ARNs that CAST AI is allowed to pass (iam:PassRole) to EC2 and EKS, e.g. the instance profile roles used by Node Configurations. If not set, iam:PassRole is allowed for any role (`role/*`). Limiting this list can block node creation when a Node Configuration is later added or updated with an instance profile role that is not on the list; keeping the list in sync is your responsibility.
- `shared_vpc_account_id` (String) AWS account ID where the VPC and subnets are located, for shared VPC setups. If not applicable, defaults to the account_id.

### Read-Only

- `iam_managed_policies` (Set of String)
- `iam_policy_json` (String)
- `iam_user_policy_json` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
